What is medical billing?

Medical billing connects a documented patient visit with a claim, a payer decision and a payment record. A practice needs to see which stage each claim has reached.

In this guide
Before submissionAfter the claim leavesClose the loop

Before submission

The front desk checks patient and insurance details. The billing team reconciles the encounter, charges and supporting documentation. An unclear entry goes back to the appropriate member of the clinical team for clarification.

After the claim leaves

A submission record shows when the claim was sent. Staff check whether it was accepted for processing and follow later payer responses. A rejection, a denial and a payment can each call for a different action.

Close the loop

Post payments and adjustments against the correct account, then investigate unresolved balances. A weekly review can identify old claims, outstanding questions and the person responsible for the next step. Cloud Haven delivers healthcare revenue work with SuperBillOne LLC.
